name: Horseshoe Lake
description:
Horseshoe Lake

In this bank Water Magic spells are always cast at expert level and spells from other schools at basic level, regardless of player's secondary skills. Eldricht Kelpies in this bank have a 50% chance to cast Weakness for 3 turns after attack.

Value: 9500
Rarity: 80

Size 1: guarded by 4x6 Eldricht Kelpies, gives 6 Priestesses (15%)
Size 2: guarded by 4x9 Eldricht Kelpies, gives 9 Priestesses (35%)
Size 3: guarded by 4x12 Eldricht Kelpies, gives 12 Priestesses (35%)
Size 4: guarded by 4x18 Eldricht Kelpies, gives 18 Priestesses (15%)

If HotA mod is enabled, Horseshoe Lake substitutes Wolf Rider Picket.
author: wnukos, Kurek (graphics)
